home.label: Voce a Voce, home page
home.title: Voce a Voce - learn your part
home.description: Voce a Voce: choir study videos, voice by voice (S/A/T/B). Follow your line on the score, with a tempo cursor, your voice highlighted and subtitles. Public-domain repertoire.

lead: Choir study videos, voice by voice (Soprano, Alto, Tenor, Bass): follow your line on the score, with a tempo cursor, your voice highlighted and the others dimmed.

how.f1_p: Your part in high-contrast black, the other voices dimmed in grey.
how.f2_p: A bar follows the rhythm of your line, on rests and fermatas too.
how.f3_p: Lyrics under your voice and per-verse subtitles, synced.
how.f4_p: First listening, slow reading, at tempo, in pairs, with the choir and finally «your turn», with your voice taken out of the mix. Chapters to jump to each section.

voicesDemo: The four voices: one highlighted, the others dimmed

sources.p: We use only public-domain scores (e.g. CPDL/ChoralWiki, IMSLP, OpenScore). The source and edition of each piece are credited in that video's description.

footer.note: Public-domain scores · arrangements and attributions credited per piece.
